headline.purpose: Functional page title, not a display face.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; border:1px solid #cdd8dc; border-radius:7px; padding:9px 13px; min-height:38px; font:600 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms,border-color 160ms; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:wait; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #218e80; outline-offset:3px; }.ds-primary { background:var(--accent,#067368); border-color:var(--accent,#067368); color:white; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#05675d; border-color:#05675d; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; border:1px solid #cdd8dc; border-radius:7px; padding:9px 13px; min-height:38px; font:600 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms,border-color 160ms; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:wait; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #218e80; outline-offset:3px; }.ds-secondary { background:white; color:#344c57; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#edf3f3; border-color:#92aaa9; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:7px; border:1px solid #cdd8dc; border-radius:7px; padding:9px 13px; min-height:38px; font:600 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms,border-color 160ms; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:wait; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #218e80; outline-offset:3px; }.ds-quiet { background:transparent; border-color:transparent; color:var(--text-muted,#566972); min-height:30px; padding:5px 9px; } .ds-quiet:hover { background:#edf3f3; border-color:#92aaa9; }

components.name: Technical Input
components.description: Editable model identifier with a visible label.
components.css: .ds-label { display:block; margin-bottom:7px; color:var(--text-main,#203039); font:600 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-input { width:100%; min-width:0; padding:9px 11px; border:1px solid #ccd7dc; border-radius:6px; background:#fbfcfc; color:var(--text-main,#203039); caret-color:var(--accent,#067368); font:12px/1.5 Consolas,monospace; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #218e80; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Dark navigation with a selected workspace.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Workspaces"><button class="ds-tab ds-selected" aria-current="page">Overview</button><button class="ds-tab">Prompt audit</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { background:var(--sidebar,#18272e); padding:16px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; } .ds-tab { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; min-height:44px; padding:11px 12px; border:0; border-radius:7px; background:transparent; color:#c0ced3; text-align:left; font:13px/1.5 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background:#253b44; color:white; } .ds-tab.ds-selected { background:#29473f; color:#c6f2df; } .ds-selected::after { content:""; width:5px; height:5px; background:#a9e7ce; border-radius:50%; margin-left:auto; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #218e80; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Tier Chips
components.description: Named semantic tiers; color remains paired with text.
components.html: LunaTerraSolAstra
components.css: .ds-chips { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:7px; } .ds-chip { display:inline-block; padding:3px 7px; border-radius:4px; font:600 12px/1.5 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-luna { color:#087363; background:#e4f2ec; } .ds-terra { color:#275b91; background:#e8f0f9; } .ds-sol { color:#806017; background:#faf1d9; } .ds-astra { color:#765099; background:#f0eaf6; }

components.name: Inspection Panel
components.html:
Connections

Inspect upstream and routing configuration.
components.css: .ds-panel { background:var(--bg-secondary,#ffffff); border:1px solid var(--border,#dce3e6); border-radius:var(--radius,12px); padding:22px; color:var(--text-main,#203039); } .ds-panel-title { margin:0; font:650 16px/1.5 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.015em; } .ds-panel-copy { margin:7px 0 0; color:var(--text-muted,#566972); font:12px/1.5 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; }

components.name: Request Ledger
components.description: Ruled record with a selectable request title.
components.html: gpt-6-luna
components.css: .ds-ledger { background:var(--bg-secondary,#ffffff); border:1px solid var(--border,#dce3e6); border-radius:var(--radius,12px); overflow:hidden; } .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:14px; align-items:center; padding:14px 22px; border-bottom:1px solid #edf1f2; } .ds-row:hover { background:#f7faf9; } .ds-request { display:block; border:0; padding:0; background:none; text-align:left; color:var(--text-main,#203039); font:12px/1.5 "Segoe UI",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-request strong { font-weight:500; } .ds-request small { display:block; margin-top:4px; color:var(--text-muted,#566972); font-size:12px; } .ds-request:hover strong { color:var(--accent,#067368); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:3px; } .ds-request:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #218e80; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-model { font:12px/1.5 Consolas,monospace; color:var(--text-main,#203039); } @media(max-width:700px) { .ds-row { padding:16px 18px; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr); gap:12px; } .ds-request { grid-column:1/-1; } }

narrative.overview:
A cool, light work surface sits beside dark ink navigation. Compact system typography, monospaced identifiers, and ruled records make routing decisions easy to inspect. Teal identifies deliberate actions and selection; tier colors retain their semantic roles.

The system serves a local developer tool: readable evidence, explicit connection states, and practical controls take precedence over decoration. The implementation is standalone HTML with inline CSS and SVG; it ships no raster assets.
keyCharacteristics: Dark navigation beside a cool light workspace.
Ruled data surfaces and restrained panel borders.
Teal actions and four named semantic tiers.
System sans text with monospaced technical values.

rules.name: The Semantic Tier Rule
rules.body: Keep Luna teal, Terra blue, Sol ochre, and Astra violet consistent across tier marks, distributions, and badges; retain text labels alongside color.

rules.name: The Technical Value Rule
rules.body: Reserve monospace for technical values and retain tabular numerals for measurements.

rules.name: The Flat Work Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary panels flat; reserve lifted depth for the modal.

dos: Do preserve readable labels alongside status and tier colors.
Do use ruled rows and flat bordered panels for inspectable data.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do stack request rows and forms at the mobile breakpoint.
donts: Don't add ornamental raster imagery to the inspection workspace.
Don't apply modal shadows to ordinary panels.
Don't use technical monospace for ordinary headings and navigation.
